notes.title: Gemini 1.1.0.1
notes.content:
- fixed some minor issues with incursion mode including:
* drop pod not being collectable unless players are in zone (despite door being opened)
* issues with triv variant enemies (gunship/droids) for incursion for maps playing as avians
- added support for custom incursion maps via new modkit
- added a safe graphics mode script "RunGeminiSafeGFX" in the base game directory to easily set and run the game at minimum graphics settings in Windows (useful for players with older/lower end gpus or for troubleshooting purposes)
- updated Chinese translation

notes.title: Gemini 1.0.1.1
notes.content: - Gemini f2p build with supporter DLC implementation

notes.title: Gemini - Spelunk Update
notes.content:
We are excited to announce the release of three new Gemini maps!

A new subaquatic warpath battleground ‘wp_spelunk’! Alongside its free-for-all counterpart ‘fdm_spelunk’ and of course for good measure a team deathmatch version of the truly magnificent ‘magmastation’. 

If you are interested in some real combat verticality, do come and check out what spelunk has to offer, not only with its (quite literally) wonderfully ‘immersed’ visuals, but wild gameplay to match. There's something for everyone to love in this avian underwater jaunt!

[previewyoutube=u4MW6QVknkI;full][/previewyoutube]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37573758/89e2b8b325f4896fed85743c578d966db8890d5d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37573758/4b9d531cf2912f5110ee6b82e259b13b211d622f.png[/img]
Also in this update:
- added a system for dedicated servers to reload the ‘serversettings’ config file on map change (so certain settings can be changed while server is running)
- workaround for a bot ho/unearthed repair issue
- fixed new lag comp system only working for the first shot of the burst on burster/repulse
- attempted to make client/server shots match up better on the shooting clients side

notes.title: Gemini 1.0.0.8
notes.content:
- wp_spelunk (wip) fixes and tweaks including:
* moved corridor crates more towards edge to improve pathing and sight lines
* fixed no droid spawning at forward bases + no super droid spawns
* improved placement / size / team priority for barricades
* fixed small tube steps pathing issues + added floor to tube (to improve path visibility)
* improved locations of and added more collectables
* added blocker volume to centre scaffolding + added some barriers to point peak spots
* fixed no team spawning when final base is being attacked
- tightened impulser rifle spread
- slightly tightened burster rifle spread
- increased chat hide delay since last message from 5 to 8 seconds

notes.title: Gemini 1.0.0.7
notes.content:
- wp_spelunk map updates (wip - art pass complete!)
- fixed spectator 'ghost' issue on larger maps (whereby enemies weren't visible in spectator cam if a player died outside of net relevancy range)
- increased net relevancy range for a number of objects / characters, and made players always relevant
- introduced a system to circumvent client movement lag when shooting

notes.title: Gemini beta 1.0.0.6
notes.content:
- wp_spelunk map updates (wip)
- warpath bots capture point structure buying improvements
- cvar ‘goal.defertobot 1’ now also lowers bots buying threshold when humans are on their team

notes.title: Gemini beta 1.0.0.5
notes.content:
- added a new map to the pvp WIP progress section "wp_spelunk"!
- fixed an oversight to the build process regarding EAC / game launching

notes.title: Gemini beta 1.0.0.4
notes.content:
- fixed an issue with cloak knights no longer being able to attack
- setup a cloak 85% radius check on radial damage to help reduce "luck" decloaking
- slinger direct / close range shots below the belt give an additional upward impulse (making it more difficult to lock someone in place)
- fixed a potential crash related to melee lag compensation hitbox system

notes.title: Gemini beta 1.0.0.3
notes.content:
- Buffed ranger equipment
* slight HP increase for sentry drone
* slight width increase for deployable barricade
- set populated servers in your region to be sorted first in the server browser

notes.title: Gemini beta 1.0.0.2
notes.content:
- added a hud based capture bar in warpath to show your teams most relevant point capture progress
- created a client rotation compensation system for melee to help improve the ‘feel’ of melee attack connections
- implemented a feature to allow admins of a server (or hosts) to execute select cvars via the in-game chatbox using an “!” followed by the command i.e. “!mp.botquota 10”
- added a new cvar ‘goal.defertobot’ to allow bots to attempt to complete the objective in holdout regardless of if a human player is alive
- slightly increased cone for client hitscan rotation compensation
- slightly reduced the screen footprint and translucency of world based health/capture bars
- lowered the max connections on PvP in-game hosted servers to 10, with a new system to still allow bots to fill up to 16 players (this still allows for full self hosted 8v8 matches, while lowering the risk of network issues from too many clients – dedicated servers are unaffected)
- prevented cloak knights from being able to attack whilst in the process of engaging the cloak
- fixed a rare issue where bots could be fixated on attempting to buy a no-longer accessible CP building if they were attempting to buy it as sudden death kicked in

notes.title: Gemini beta 1.0.0.1
notes.content:
- worked around an issue with the corpse cleanup system, where in some hectic battles the server could destroy a dead player before its tornoff to some clients
- slightly increased the size of small droids and poppers hitboxes
- updated Spanish translation
